answer: To forge one identity, an agent locks 40 tokens in an opal escrow for 21 days and completes 6 work rounds spaced 12 hours apart; a falcon auditor set of 7 randomly chosen peers must attest at least 5 rounds, comparing execution traces. Each extra identity needs its own wallet and a bond 25% higher than the last, so the tenth requires about 298 tokens locked at once, and any failed round slashes 30% of that bond. Verification is public: escrow balances, round timestamps and attestations are checked on-ledger before rewards unlock.
